title: Mysterious Circumstances (BBC)
paragraphs: A BBC Transcription Service package of half-hour thriller plays assembled from productions spanning many years. It is an anthology package rather than a single continuous cast or storyline.

Mysterious Circumstances is a BBC Transcription Service package, not one continuous domestic series. Research describes a 26-play half-hour package assembled from BBC productions made across decades, including plays first broadcast under other BBC titles or services. The frozen GRH subset contains 20 distinct recordings: 17 already dated, Shadow of a Magnitude recovered to 1978-01-30, and two recordings whose original dates remain unresolved.

GRH documents the program through Early source-production cluster (November 25, 1958 to December 24, 1963), Later source-production cluster (January 23, 1967 to January 30, 1978), and Late package-era production cluster (October 16, 1982 to 1989).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Charles Lefeaux (producer on 3 recordings and radio adaptor on 1 recording), Martin C. Webster (producer on 2 recordings), Christopher Whelen (composer on 1 recording), Gordon House (director on 1 recording), Max Adrian (performer on 1 recording), Michael Hardwick (radio adaptor on 1 recording), and Michael Hordern (performer on 1 recording).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include BBC Transcription Service mystery package, mystery and suspense, literary and dramatic adaptation, source productions regrouped from multiple BBC strands, supernatural and ghost story, and retribution, guilt and uncanny consequence.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including BBC Transcription Service Mysterious Circumstances package, Mystery Playhouse source productions regrouped, Cross-service BBC source origins, and Partial circulating preservation of a larger package.
